t: Chaburot sheokelim beharbeh meqomot mah dinam
s: Chaburot sheokelim beharbeh meqomot mah dinam, ubo d' seipim: b' chaburot sheokelot bebayit echad o beb' battim sheen derek harabbim mapseqet benehem, im miqtzatan roim ellu et ellu — mitztorpot lezimmun, veim lav — enan mitztorpot, ella ellu mezammenin leatzman veellu mezammenin leatzman. Veim yesh shammash echad lishtehen — hu metzorpan, ap al pi shello akal immahem:

Vekol zeh keshenniknesu mittechilla lesham al daat lehitztarep, abal bistam enan mitztorpot, apillu roim ellu et ellu vehem bebayit echad veshammash echad lishtehen, shehare enan mitztorpot lezimmun ella im ken qabeu beshulchan echad leekol yachad, sheaz nechshabim kegup echad, uberaka achat lekullam, vekan kol chabura hi leatzmah, mah sheen ken keshenniknesu venechlequ leb' chaburot al daat lehitztarep libraka achat — hare zeh keillu niknesu venitchabberu bachabura achat, sheiqqar hachibbur vehatztzerup hu hakkavvana lehitchabber. Abal im niknesu venechlequ setam shello al daat lehitztarep, ap al pi shebbishat birkat "hammotzi" haya bedatam lehitztarep — shub en kavvanatam moelet lechabberam uletzorpam apillu lebirkat "hammotzi" atzmah, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z, kol shekken lebirkat hammazon. Veim niknesu zo achar zo, ap al pi shehashsheniyya niknesa al daat lehitztarep im harishona, im harishona lo haya bedatah kelal bishat kenisatah al hashsheniyya lehitztarep immah, ella niknesa setam — enan mitztorpot. Lepikak, bisudot gedolot bimqomot shenniknasim bazeh achar zeh — yezammenu kol chabura leatzmah:

Akelu miqtzatan babbayit umiqtzatan chutz labbayit, im hambarek yosheb al hammiptan — hu metzorpan, lepi shehu yakol lirot ellu veellu bahapikat panayv lekan ulekan, vahare zeh kemiqtzatan roim ellu et ellu, shehu nechshab meellu umeellu, shehare motzi et kullam yede chobatam:

Kol maqom shemmitztorpot b' chaburot — tzarik sheyyishmeu shettehen kol birkat hammazon bebeur mippi hambarek, ulepachot birkat "hazzan", kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"g vqtz"g. Umi shello shama birkat hazzimmun shehu "nebarek sheakalnu mishshello" bebeur — eno yakol laanot immahem "baruk sheakalnu", ella oneh acharehem "amen", ledibre haomer ken be"bareku" shebbebet hakkeneset, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"z. Ukebar nitbaer sham sheen debarayv iqqar:
